title: 第9章 风雨欲来又怎么样依旧老婆孩子热坑头第10章 长子降生杀人夜李长生的血性
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 李长生点点头，安慰：“也许明天一早就回来了。”
江翠萍闻言，放下心来：“那就好，夫君你也早点休息吧。”
看着妻子进房的背影，李长生脸上的笑容，瞬间消失得无影无踪。
似乎自己的猜测变成了现实。
李长生依然坐在院子藤椅上，懒洋洋地晒太阳。
家里还有个娇滴滴的小媳妇。
才区区几十块灵石，不足以让他抛妻弃家，远走高飞。
就连平日里聚在一起吹牛的老头们，也一个个闭门不出。
仿佛大家都预感到了什么。
空气中弥漫着压抑的气息。
李长生盘膝，坐在昏暗的客厅里，没有点灯。
如同融入了黑暗的雕塑。
李长生缓缓吐出一口浊气，站起身，走到窗边，透过缝隙，看向外面漆黑的夜色，复杂的心情夹带着愤怒。
content_en:
Li Changsheng nodded and comforted: "Maybe he will be back early tomorrow morning."
Hearing this, Jiang Cuiping felt relieved and said, "That's good. Husband, you should also rest early."
Li Changsheng nodded:
"Well, you go to bed first."
"I'll sit down for a while."
Seeing his wife's back entering the room, the smile on Li Changsheng's face disappeared without a trace in an instant.
One day passed.
Old man Du didn't come back.
It seems that my guess has become a reality.
……
the next day.
Li Changsheng was still sitting on the wicker chair in the yard, lazily basking in the sun.
But my heart has sunk.
It is true that Old Man Du is greedy for money.
It's not fake to be lustful.
But he cherishes his life even more.
There is also a delicate little daughter-in-law at home.
Just a few dozen spiritual stones were not enough to allow him to abandon his wife and family and fly away.
If the road is open.
It's long past time to come back.
today.
The resettlement area is quieter.
Even the old men who usually get together to brag are staying behind closed doors.
It seemed that everyone had a premonition of something.
There is a depressing atmosphere in the air.
…
Late at night on the third day.
Li Changsheng sat cross-legged in the dark living room without lighting the lamp.
Like a sculpture immersed in darkness.
Three days and three nights.
There is still no news from Old Man Du.
The answer is already obvious.
"My guess has become a reality."
"Old man Du can't come back."
Li Changsheng slowly exhaled a breath, stood up, walked to the window, and looked out at the dark night through the gap, with complicated emotions mixed with anger.
This is catching a turtle in a urn.
Lock everyone up.
Kill whenever you want,
Just kill when.
I want to kill a few,
